notes: v1.14.588 — INTEL-DOCK SHIP 1. The dock's fourth slot changes identity: EXIT (hold) leaves for the last row of SYS and the DCT Assistant ghost takes the cell it vacated. Owner rulings 2026-09-10 (OWNER-RULINGS.md INTEL-DOCK item 1 — Option A, four slots COMMAND/BUILD/TOOLS/GHOST, Option B's fifth slot REJECTED; and item 3 — the commissioned art). Spec docs/SHIP-HANDOFF-INTEL-DOCK-SHIP1.md, evidence docs/INTEL-DOCK-PHASE0-EVIDENCE.md. ONE VISIBLE CHANGE: the dock's composition. ⚠ WHY .588 AND NOT .587: .587 is burned by the unmerged rack-pose-determinism branch and the house rule is never to reuse a number. WHY THIS IS ONE ATOMIC SHIP AND NOT TWO: #rd-botnav is grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr), so the ghost could only occupy cell 4 if EXIT left in the same edit — splitting them would ship a visibly empty cell. THE GHOST: icons/phantom-nav-ghost-v1-256.webp, the owner's commissioned cut, measured before install against docs/DOCK-ICON-BATCH-SPEC.md — VP8X with a real 5,016-byte alpha chunk, 256x256, subject 180x218 (longest side 218 against a 226 target, 3.5 percent under, accepted: it renders 46px against the row's 47.7px, a 1.7px difference at real size), padding 19 top/bottom and 38 sides (spec floor 15), ink coverage 42.6 percent (band 25-45). Its 1024 master and the 256 agree exactly, so the 256 came from the master rather than being cut separately. The first delivery was rejected and re-rendered: it was a bare lossy VP8 at 1092x1117 with NO alpha channel at all — the checkerboard in the preview was the viewer's backdrop, not the file. EXIT MOVED WITH ITS id UNCHANGED, and that is the design: rd_initExit() looks #rd-exit up BY ID, not by position, so the hold gesture, rd_holdGesture, rd_freeze, rd_wake, the freeze curtain and the boot restore are all wired by existing code with ZERO JavaScript change in this ship. Moving the element moved the control; the freeze semantics are byte-identical. ⛔ ONE CSS RE-SCOPE WAS MANDATORY AND IS THE SUBTLE PART: `body.rd #rd-exit` carried the dock cell's geometry (min-width 56, min-height 56, margin-right 48, flex-column) and was NOT dock-scoped, so it would have followed the element into the SYS panel and forced a 56px flex column with a 48px right margin inside a list row. It is now `body.rd #rd-botnav #rd-exit`, which matches nothing and is kept as the record of what the cell was. The charge bar survives unchanged (body.rd #rd-exit .rd-exit-charge is position:absolute, so the new row carries position:relative and overflow:hidden to host it) and two new rules give the row the arming feedback the dock cell had. OFFLINE: the ghost DIMS to 0.30 and STAYS TAPPABLE. ⛔ It deliberately does NOT use the generic [data-requires-net="1"] hook, which sets pointer-events:none and stamps an OFFLINE pill via ::after — cramped in a ~94px cell, and it would make the ghost a tappable control that does nothing, which Contract B14 forbids. The tap lands and the sheet explains, exactly as the Command assistant card does today. DOOR LEDGER: EXIT re-homes (0), the ghost re-homes an existing opener onto the existing A-2 sheet (#vaSheet / va_intentHtml are untouched — the dock does not rebuild the sheet, it opens it). ⚠ NET +1 UNTIL SHIP 2: ruling 2 retires #cc-asst, which is a SECOND visible change on a different surface and is therefore its own ship. Until it lands the assistant has two doors. Stated, not hidden. PINNED by test/e2e/55-intel-dock.spec.js (8): four .botitem ending in bn-ghost and #rd-exit absent from the dock; the 44px gloved floor on all four; the ghost draws its own cut and the bytes actually decoded (a 404 still renders as an empty box); a tap opens the sheet; offline dims AND stays tappable (both halves); EXIT is the LAST row of the SYS panel, present not deleted, never a .botitem; a plain tap does not freeze; and rd_initExit actually wired the moved control. NOT IN THIS SHIP: retiring #cc-asst (Ship 2), the offline needs-signal sheet, #cs-nav-ext on the desktop side nav (INTEL-DOCK is silent on it; default is leave, per the .576 pattern), and SYS's other rows. Anchors: dct-ios.html stamp - #bn-ghost in #bn-rail - #rd-exit as the last .hdr-agg-row in #hdr-agg-panel - the re-scoped dock geometry rule and the #bn-ghost offline rules in CSS - sw.js PRECACHE_URLS - version.json. DEVICE VERIFY OWED: the dock shows no EXIT and four slots ending in the ghost; the ghost reads as a ghost at 54px beside the other four (G-1's acceptance — do the irises read as circuitry, as texture, or as two lit ovals?); airplane mode dims it and a tap still opens the sheet; SYS's bottom row is EXIT and a 0.85s hold freezes while a tap does not.
